question: Does the frozen adaptive coverage advantage persist among stable families, rather than being driven only by rare or background families?
design: Descriptive post-hoc decomposition of existing fixed selection orders; no retuning or new model inference.

primary_comparison.metric: Number of distinct families with median partition Jaccard >=0.5, counted over unique parent photos

secondary: Stable families on at least two selected photos
Rare families with 2-4 parent photos versus families with at least 5
All existing shortcut-risk strata 0..4, separately; no eligible families removed
Stable families spanning two selected global communities
interpretation: Partition stability is not semantic correctness. Census risk/coherence scores are previous model adjudications and inform the selection policy, so their decomposition is not independent validation. No human productivity or novel-photo generalization claims.
compute: Lightweight CPU tabulation of 129 family memberships and saved orders; no GPU, no extraction, zero cloud cost.
